b:
I want those who come near me with love,
talking literature under a moon of joy
I want to fly like a cloud
I want youth to stay in my body
I want to set foot in every forest and field
and freeze in time
I want to put flowers in a woman's hair;
I want to lean on her breast and sleep
I want talent and strength
I want to hold what I sought
Words, meaning and delicious Tamil:
I want them with me like a shadow, never leaving
And if I cannot have all that I want,
I want Bharathi alone, every day
note: This echoes Subramania Bharathi's famous poem of wishes, each line ending "vēṇṭum" ("I want").
